Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consists of the secretome (proteins secreted into media) which was specifically enriched using BONCAT (azide-alkyne cycloaddition) on agarose resin before on-bead digestion. This constitutes an affinity-purified scope. Mixed species flag is true due to the presence of fetal bovine serum (FBS) proteins in the SCM samples and the use of a composite human-FBS database.
